light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the layered blade-scale soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (storm_bear / vulture_creature / azure_scale_mage lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: about one blade-scale length: real crevices darken, not the whole layered coat (batch lesson: AO darkens the basecolor below the sheet)
light.ao_fill_why: AO texels under 0.04 (bake origins inside the scale soup) refilled from valid neighbours
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner scale shells) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the blade-scale low unwraps into thousands of islands; the default margin starves the atlas (storm_bear / vulture_creature idiom)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): Pixal3D copied the sheet's 3/4 FRONT by building the whole assassin turned about Z. Measured on the v1 low (renders/shadowscale/_light/prerepose_low.npz, stage-1 frame): head z 5.4..6.95 best mirror plane yaw -41.5 deg through (0.32, 0) with p99 0.146 u (x = 0: 1.237); head slabs z 5.0..5.8 / 5.8..6.95 agree (-41.0 / -42.0); the two painted red eyes sit at lateral -0.139 / +0.229 about that plane, z 5.956 / 5.935 (dz 0.021), snout tip lateral +0.075: the face is TURNED, not sculpted crooked; the two feet lie on a line at -41 deg (side by side across the turned body). +41.5 deg about the origin puts the head plane at x +0.24 and the hip slabs at x 0.00..+0.08; to x -0.10 splits that lean (head +0.14, hips -0.06). One rigid turn (no vertex moves relative to another); the repose below works in this turned frame

rig.spine_why: v2, turned frame (light.yaw +41.5, to x -0.10): torso slab medians y -0.23 (z 2.2) .. -0.61 (z 4.6); neck = the v1 neck joint turned (0.04, -0.54, 4.9); the head bone runs along the face's own forward axis on the head plane x +0.14 (snout tip turned: x +0.22, y -2.51, z 5.32), so heading -y is ~0 deg and the head stays as generated

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose. The -x leg's outward splay (ankle x -1.46 vs the +x ankle +0.50) is pose: both legs carried onto the planted, upright +x leg (match L, as azure_scale_mage), both feet planted on z 0. Offline on the v1 low: leg stretch p99 2.32 (mean: 2.25 but a wide A-stance the sheet does not draw); falloff 0.12 was worse (3.26); plant_radius 0.8 (run 1 at 0.5 left coat-fan spikes around the -x foot 0.112 u below the floor, so the export centring floated both feet 0.11 u; offline at 0.8: lowest point -0.024 u, -x foot +0.029)

the arms mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x arm hung ~1.5 u further forward across the chest); match L (both arms hanging) pulled the front cloth harder offline (arm stretch p99 5.57 vs 2.93); no plant, the claws hang free
